title: Remove Diagnostics Tdarr console render flat export
summary: Removed the Diagnostics Tdarr console render transitional flat window export while preserving the namespace-backed mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView member, updated the browser smoke to use the namespace path, regenerated the WebView public contract, and updated flat-export inventory/current-state counts from 491 to 490.
reason: Continue opportunistic WebView flat export cleanup by reducing direct window.* compatibility aliases only where namespace-first access is already guarded and tested.
behavior_before: diagnosticsView.js exported renderTdarrMatrixConsole both through window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView and as a direct window.renderTdarrMatrixConsole compatibility alias. The Diagnostics browser smoke still called the flat alias. Inventories reported 491 flat exports total and 79 Diagnostics flat exports.
behavior_after: diagnosticsView.js keeps renderTdarrMatrixConsole on window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView but no longer assigns the direct window.renderTdarrMatrixConsole alias. The Diagnostics browser smoke calls the namespace path. Inventories and current-state docs report 490 flat exports total and 78 Diagnostics flat exports.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_local_api.py asserts renderTdarrMatrixConsole remains namespace-exported and the flat alias assignment is absent.
tests/webview/test_webview_browser_diagnostics_handoff_smoke.py now exercises the namespace-backed Tdarr console renderer.
manual_validation: rg -n "window\.renderTdarrMatrixConsole\s*=|typeof window\.renderTdarrMatrixConsole|window\.renderTdarrMatrixConsole\(" apps/desktop/webview/static tests Docs (only the negative regression assertion matched)
rollback_plan: Restore the removed window.renderTdarrMatrixConsole assignment, switch the browser smoke back to the flat alias if needed, regenerate the WebView public contract and summaries, revert the flat-export count changes, and rerun the same WebView validation ladder.
